title: Ternary materials discovery using human-in-the-loop generative machine learning
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19126-19131
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00427F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Brandon Wilfong, Alexander New, Gregory Bassen, Wyatt Bustine, Michael J. Pekala, Nam Q. Le, Karun K. Rao, Elizabeth A. Pogue, Eddie Gienger, Michał J. Winiarski, Tyrel M. McQueen, Christopher D. Stiles
We describe the use of a generative machine learning model to generate novel crystal structures, predict their thermodynamic stability, and experimentally verify generated material candidates LiZn2Pt, LiZn2Pd, and NiPt2Ga in a single workflow..
